goal: Play like a new player for the first few minutes: get your plot (walk onto a CLAIM gate or wait for auto-claim), watch cash come in, walk onto the glowing green Dropper 2 buy pad as soon as you can afford it, keep buying the next pads as they appear, open the SHOP with the SHOP button and buy an upgrade there, press REBIRTH once you can afford it, look at the TOP TYCOONS board in the plaza, and report anything confusing, broken or unfair
summary: The playtester auto-claimed a plot, watched cash rise, bought Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Silver Ore from the shop, and bought Dropper 3 and Cash x1.5 from the world pads. It pressed REBIRTH several times while underfunded (cash peaked near $2K against a $5000 cost), so no rebirth happened. It never looked at the TOP TYCOONS board, and later shop Buy buttons (Cash x1.5, Gold Ore) did not fire, so the goal was only partly completed.

bugs.title: Shop Buy buttons for lower cards (Cash x1.5, Gold Ore) do not fire
bugs.evidence: Steps 10, 11, 12, 15 and 16 pressed Card_mult1 ($300) and Card_tier_gold ($500) by path and by text. Every result said 'button did NOT fire' while cash was $534 to $1.4K, which covers both prices. The cards still showed 'Buy' and cash did not drop. The earlier Buy presses on Dropper 2, Speed 1 and Silver Ore (steps 2, 3, 5) worked. The failing buttons sit lower in the list (y=640 and y=744), so they may be clipped or blocked by another UI layer, or their handler may not respond. Cash x1.5 was only bought by walking onto the world pad at step 13. Gold Ore was never bought.

bugs.title: Underfunded REBIRTH gives no clear feedback and its panel never opened
bugs.evidence: RebirthGui.RebirthButton was pressed at steps 4, 9 and 14, and the probe shows rebirth_denied=4. The label only showed progress ('REBIRTH $5000 (1%)', '(9%)', '(21%)'). The UI coverage report says the REBIRTH panel was never opened. It is unclear whether a new player sees any explanation of why the rebirth was denied.

bugs.title: Income rate display dropped after buying Silver Ore
bugs.evidence: After the Silver Ore purchase at step 5, the HUD '+$6/s' became '+$5/s' (flagged at step 6). A better ore tier should not lower the displayed income. This may be a transient fluctuation, since the evidence is thin.

bugs.title: TotalEarned stat looks seeded or miscounted
bugs.evidence: At step 8 the event effect showed TotalEarned going from 1000000000428 to 1000000000452 while cash was only about $210. A debug value may be leaking, which could distort the TOP TYCOONS board.

bugs.title: Owned items still show buy prices on the world pads
bugs.evidence: The Silver Ore, Dropper 3 and Cash x1.5 pads still appear in the touchables list with their prices (for example 'Silver Ore | $60' at step 8) after the shop marked them Owned. This is confusing for a new player.
